authority.source_authority: GitHub Actions run 32209361623 is authoritative for the post-ingest DATA_MAP delta; current main supplies repository policy; Lowell authorized completion of this CI repair. This manifest is candidate coordination evidence only, and Lowell retains merge and final-release authority.

non_overlap_statement: Only root-ci-repair-writer may edit the T611 worktree. The independent-release-checker remains read-only, and neither role may access or modify M8 content.

roles.why_needed: The published draft needs one accountable writer to apply the exact post-ingest DATA_MAP delta and refresh its task, mesh, ledger, and handoff evidence.
roles.mission: Repair PR 196's DATA_MAP freshness failure without changing publication meaning, payload boundaries, M7 evidence, or M8 state.
inputs: Lowell authorization to complete the CI repair
roles.authority: May edit only .ai/control/DATA_MAP.md, .ai/control/handoff_ledger.jsonl, .ai/tasks/T611.task.yaml, .ai/context/agent_work/T611/agent_mesh_manifest.v3.json, and .ai/handoffs/T611/handoff.md, then commit and push the repair to the existing draft PR. May not merge, publish a final release, access M8 content, or begin convergence.
acceptance_conditions: The DATA_MAP diff exactly matches GitHub's post-ingest schema-count and schema-row delta.
No sparse-worktree inventory deltas are committed.
Required local gates and the replacement GitHub Actions check pass.
stop_conditions: The generated diff includes any data inventory change beyond GitHub's post-ingest evidence.
Any repair would require M8 access, publication payload changes, merge authority, or a final release.

readiness_conditions: The final diff is frozen and local gates pass.

roles.why_needed: The author cannot independently approve a public-facing, hash-bound release surface or its post-publication CI repair.
roles.mission: Inspect the frozen repair diff and validation evidence, verify scope and M8 isolation, and confirm or block the draft-publication gate.
inputs: current T611 handoff and validation results
roles.authority: Read-only independent review; cannot edit, push, merge, publish a final release, inspect M8 content, or self-author evidence.
acceptance_conditions: The repair matches the observed CI failure and introduces no unrelated or authority-expanding change.
The exact replacement remote head is green before completion.
stop_conditions: The repair changes publication claims, payload, source pins, or M8/convergence boundaries.
Required evidence is missing or the diff changes after review.

readiness_conditions: Writer validation passes and the repair diff is frozen.

proof_obligations.description: Bind the committed DATA_MAP to the post-ingest CI environment rather than the sparse publication worktree.
Keep the publication metadata-only and all merge, final-release, payload, and convergence gates unchanged.
Verify that the CI repair does not read or mutate protected M8 content and does not start comparison or convergence.

unresolved_decisions.summary: PR merge and final GitHub release remain separately Lowell-owned after this CI repair.

reconciliations.reason: The original publication build is complete; the remaining bounded mission is CI freshness repair.
The immutable inventory is unchanged and the CI repair does not inspect M7 payload objects.
The privacy/license boundary and release archive are unchanged; the repair adds only generated control-plane metadata and task evidence.
The existing non-author checker remains the appropriate reviewer; its dependency changes from the completed publication writer to the bounded CI-repair writer.
